cols.description: Specify the width of the screen. 0 means autodetection.

exclude_lines.description: Regex patterns for lines to exclude from diffing. Not compatible with line-numbers option.

head.description: Consider only the first N lines of each file. 0 means all lines.

highlight.description: Color by changing the background color instead of the foreground color.

labels.description: Labels to override file names in the header. Use twice for left and right.

line_numbers.description: Generate output with line numbers. Not compatible with exclude-lines option.

no_bold.description: Use non-bold colors; recommended for solarized theme.

no_headers.description: Don't label the left and right sides with their file names.

report_identical_files.description: Report when two files are the same.

truncate.description: Truncate long lines instead of wrapping them.

unified_numlines.description: Number of context lines to print.

whole_file.description: Show the whole file instead of just changed lines and context.

permissions.description: Compare file permissions as well as content.

strip_trailing_cr.description: Strip trailing carriage return at the end of an input line.

color_map.description: Choose which colors are used for which items.

is_git_diff.description: Show the real file name when displaying git-diff result.

exclude_patterns.description: File patterns to exclude from comparison.
